name: Balaeno SEO Intelligence
author: balaeno

sections.description:
Balaeno SEO Intelligence is a lightweight SEO optimization plugin designed for WordPress and WooCommerce websites.

The plugin helps website owners identify and improve common SEO issues directly within WordPress.

Features include:

  • SEO title management
  • Meta description management
  • Readability analysis
  • Image SEO auditing
  • Content optimization recommendations
  • SEO scoring dashboard
  • Missing SEO element detection
  • WooCommerce product SEO support
  • Search engine friendly metadata generation
  • Content quality insights

Whether you manage a blog, business website or WooCommerce store, Balaeno SEO Intelligence helps you improve your content and SEO performance from within WordPress.

Premium Version

Balaeno SEO Intelligence Pro is available separately and includes additional advanced SEO tools, reporting capabilities and optimization features.

Additional premium features may include:

  • Advanced SEO auditing
  • Enhanced content analysis
  • Advanced WooCommerce SEO tools
  • Open Graph and social media enhancements
  • Additional schema and structured data options
  • Advanced reporting and insights
  • Priority support

The WordPress.org version is fully functional on its own and does not require the premium version to operate.

Learn more:
https://wpquicklook.com
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the Balaeno SEO menu in the WordPress admin area.
  4. Configure your SEO settings and begin optimizing your content.
sections.faq:
Does this work with WooCommerce?

Yes. Balaeno SEO Intelligence supports WooCommerce products and product SEO optimization.

Can I set custom SEO titles and meta descriptions?

Yes. The plugin allows you to create custom SEO titles and meta descriptions for supported content types.

Does the plugin require an external account?

No. The WordPress.org version works independently and does not require a third-party account.

Is there a premium version available?

Yes. Balaeno SEO Intelligence Pro is available separately and includes additional advanced SEO and reporting features.
